```{r}
# define functions
RPM <- function(x) ((x/sum(x) *1000000) + 1)
average <- function(x,y) ((x + y) /2)
L2FC <- function(x,y) (log2(x/y))
zscore <- function(x) ((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
```

```{r}
# Define the correct folder path
input_dir <- "./A427_Cas9"

# List all read_count.tsv files in the directory
files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "read_count.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Check if files exist
if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No files found! Check the directory path and file names.")
}

# Read the first file
file <- files[1]
raw_reads <- read_tsv(file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub(".*/|\\.tsv", "", file), -c(sgRNA, gene)) %>%  # Replace column name with filename
  rename(gene = gene, sgRNA = sgRNA)  # Keep original names for reference columns

# Iterate over remaining files and perform left joins
for (file in files[-1]) {
  temp_df <- read_tsv(file, col_types = cols()) %>%
    select(-gene) %>%  # Remove the redundant "gene" column
    rename_with(~ gsub(".*/|\\.tsv", "", file), -sgRNA)  # Replace column name with filename
  
  # Ensure sgRNA column exists
  if (!"sgRNA" %in% colnames(temp_df)) {
    stop(paste("Missing 'sgRNA' column in:", file))
  }

  raw_reads <- left_join(raw_reads, temp_df, by = "sgRNA")
}

# Print the merged dataframe
print(raw_reads)
```

```{r}
#replicate correlation -all reads control
rep1 <-
  data %>%
  select(sgRNA, A427Cas9_Control_R1.read_count)

rep2 <-
  data %>%
  select(sgRNA, A427Cas9_Control_R2.read_count)

rep_correlation <- left_join(rep1, rep2) %>% 
  filter(is.na(A427Cas9_Control_R1.read_count) ==FALSE & is.na(A427Cas9_Control_R2.read_count)==FALSE )
r1 <- cor(rep_correlation$A427Cas9_Control_R1.read_count, rep_correlation$A427Cas9_Control_R2.read_count, method = "pearson")
```

```{r}
#make a replicate versus replicate heatmap for the readcoutns from pycroquet forward
# 1) pick columns: *_pyc_reads AND containing _R1_ or _R2_
read_cols <- names(data) %>%
  (\(x) x[
    str_detect(x, "read_count$") &   # ends with '.read_counts'
      str_detect(x, "_R[12]")           # contains _R1_ or _R2_
  ])()

# 2) build pretty labels + ordering (group by sample, then R1/R2)
meta <- tibble(col = read_cols) %>%
  mutate(
    rep = str_match(col, "_R([12])")[, 2],
    sample = col %>%
      str_replace("_R[12]", "_") %>%
      str_remove(".read_count$"),
    label = paste0(str_replace_all(sample, "_", " "), " R", rep)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, as.integer(rep))

# 3) numeric matrix + correlations
mat <- data %>%
  select(all_of(meta$col)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  as.matrix()

cor_mat <- cor(mat, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# rename rows/cols with pretty labels
colnames(cor_mat) <- meta$label
rownames(cor_mat) <- meta$label

# ---- 4) long form + keep LOWER triangle incl diagonal ----
cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rename(y = Var1, x = Var2, r = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    x = factor(x, levels = meta$label),
    y = factor(y, levels = meta$label),
    ix = as.integer(x),
    iy = as.integer(y)
  ) %>%
  filter(iy >= ix)

# 5) plot: diagonal/lower-triangle heatmap
plot1<-ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(r), "", sprintf("%.2f", r))), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red",
                      limits = c(0.2, 1.0), oob = squish) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "left") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
plot1
ggsave("Cas9_reads_Pearson.eps", width = 8, height = 8, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
#replicate correlation - control versus RMC-6236
rep1 <-
  data %>%
  select(sgRNA, L2FC_A427_CTRL_plasmid_average_zscore)

rep2 <-
  data %>%
  select(sgRNA, L2FC_A427_RMC6236_plasmid_average_zscore)

rep_correlation <- left_join(rep1, rep2) %>% 
  filter(is.na(L2FC_A427_CTRL_plasmid_average_zscore) ==FALSE & is.na(L2FC_A427_RMC6236_plasmid_average_zscore)==FALSE)

r <- cor(rep_correlation$L2FC_A427_CTRL_plasmid_average_zscore, rep_correlation$L2FC_A427_RMC6236_plasmid_average_zscore, method = "pearson")
```

```{r}
#control versus RMC example

geom_pointdensity(position = pos, alpha = 1, size =0.5) +
geom_hline(yintercept=c(0,0),linetype="dotted") +
geom_vline(xintercept=c(0,0),linetype="dotted") +
scale_shape_manual(values =c(19, 1)) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(L2FC_A427_RMC6236_plasmid_average_zscore > zscore_threshold, gene, "")), size=3, position=pos, max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.2) +
  labs(colour = "density", x = "A427 control versus plasmid (z-score)", y = "A427 RMC-6236 versus plasmid (z-score)") +
        annotate("text", y = -1.2, x = 4.5, label = paste("r =", round(r, 2)), parse = FALSE, size = 3.5) +
theme_classic()
plot1
ggsave("gRNAs_RMC_versus_control_Cas9.eps", width = 5, height = 4, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
#wrangling MAGeCK dataframes - significance BI2865
MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 <- dplyr::rename(MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, gene = id)
MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, pvalue = ifelse(neg.lfc< 0, neg.p.value, pos.p.value))
MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, fdr = ifelse(neg.lfc< 0, neg.fdr, pos.fdr))
MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, neg_log_10_p = (-1*log10(pvalue)))
MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, legend = ifelse(neg.lfc>0 & pvalue <0.05 & fdr <0.1, "enriched", ifelse(neg.lfc<0 & pvalue <0.05 & fdr <0.1, "depleted", "not significant")))
MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, rank = rank(neg.lfc))
```

```{r}
#volcano plot BI2865
plot1 <- ggplot(subset(MAGeCK_BI2865), aes(x=neg.lfc, y= neg_log_10_p, size = fdr, colour = legend)) +
geom_point(shape =1) +
geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(neg.lfc > 2 & neg_log_10_p > 5 |  legend == "depleted" & neg.lfc < -2 | legend != "not significant" & neg_log_10_p > 4 |  gene %in% c("ILK", "NF1", "FGFR1"), gene, "")), size=3, colour =  "black", max.overlaps = Inf) +
theme_classic() +
scale_colour_manual(values=c("salmon2", "blue", "grey70"), na.value="grey80") +
    scale_size(transform = "reverse", range = c(0.1,3.5) ) +
       labs(color = "", size = "FDR") +labs(title= "") + xlab("Log2 fold change") + ylab("-Log10 (P-value)")
plot1
```

```{r}
#join lfc tables together

# List of tables
tables <- list(MAGeCK_ACBI3 = MAGeCK_ACBI3, MAGeCK_ACBI3_exp1 = MAGeCK_ACBI3_exp1, MAGeCK_ACBI3_exp2 = MAGeCK_ACBI3_exp2, MAGeCK_MRTX1133 = MAGeCK_MRTX1133, MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp1 = MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp1, MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp2 = MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp2, MAGeCK_BI2865 = MAGeCK_BI2865, MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1 = MAGeCK_BI2865_exp1, MAGeCK_BI2865_exp2 = MAGeCK_BI2865_exp2, MAGeCK_RMC6236 = MAGeCK_RMC6236, MAGeCK_RMC6236_exp1 = MAGeCK_RMC6236_exp1, MAGeCK_RMC6236_exp2 = MAGeCK_RMC6236_exp2, MAGeCK_Control_plasmid = MAGeCK_Control_plasmid, MAGeCK_Control_plasmid_exp1 = MAGeCK_Control_plasmid_exp1, MAGeCK_Control_plasmid_exp2 = MAGeCK_Control_plasmid_exp2, MAGeCK_Control_T0 = MAGeCK_Control_T0, MAGeCK_Control_T0_exp1 = MAGeCK_Control_T0_exp1, MAGeCK_Control_T0_exp2 = MAGeCK_Control_T0_exp2)

# Function to join tables with suffixes
merged_df <- reduce(names(tables), function(df, name) {
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(rename_with(tables[[name]], ~ paste0(., "_", name), -gene))
  }
  full_join(df, rename_with(tables[[name]], ~ paste0(., "_", name), -gene), by = "gene")
}, .init = NULL)

print(merged_df)
```

```{r}
#replicate correlation - MRTX1133

  merged_df %>%
  select(gene, neg.lfc_MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp2)

  filter(is.na(neg.lfc_MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp1) ==FALSE & is.na(neg.lfc_MAGeCK_MRTX1133_exp2)==FALSE)
```

```{r}
#heatmap for key genes and lfc
heat_map <-
  merged_df %>%
   filter(gene %in% c("PPIA", "VHL", "PTEN", "NF1", "FGFR1", "RPL22", "TSC2", "NPRL3")) %>%
      select(contains(c("gene", "neg.lfc"))) %>%
      select(-contains(c("exp1", "exp2"))) %>%
  select(!("neg.lfc_MAGeCK_Control_T0")) %>%
  rename(control = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_Control_plasmid) %>%
  rename(MRTX1133 = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_MRTX1133) %>%
  rename("RMC-6236" = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_RMC6236) %>%
  rename(ACBI3 = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_ACBI3) %>%
  rename("BI-2865" = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_BI2865)

df_numeric <- heat_map %>%
  select(gene, everything()) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene")  # Set gene column as row names

# Convert to a matrix for pheatmap
df_matrix <- as.matrix(df_numeric)

# Define color palette
color_palette <- rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100))

# Define breaks centered at 0
max_val <- max(abs(df_matrix))  # Get max absolute value
breaks <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length.out = 101)  # Ensure 0 is in the center

# Create heatmap with centered colors
pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "none",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_rownames = TRUE,  # Show gene names as row names
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main = "",
  color = color_palette,  
  breaks = breaks,  # Ensure 0 is centered
  border_color = NA,
  width = 4, height = 4
) 

pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "none",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_rownames = TRUE,  # Show gene names as row names
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main = "",
  color = color_palette,  
  breaks = breaks,  # Ensure 0 is centered
  border_color = NA,
  filename = file.path("figures_export", "Fig1b.2.pdf"),  # or .png
  width = 4, height = 4
) 
```

```{r}
# add a FORWARD guide column (reverse reverse complement for - strand seq)
# add 5' G for non-G starting guides. You can use this to ORDER GUIDE libraries (add appropriate Gibson cloning adapters)

# add a G for the expression from U6 promoter by replacing the base at pos. 1 if, it is not a G
data <- mutate(data, G_guide = paste0("G", sequence))

# primers
# forward_primer
data <- mutate(data, for_primer = paste0("CACC", G_guide))

# reverse_primer
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = G_guide)
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "A", "t"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "T", "a"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "C", "g"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "G", "c"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_to_upper(rev_primer))

data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = paste0(substr(rev_primer, 20, 20), substr(rev_primer, 19, 19),substr(rev_primer, 18, 18),substr(rev_primer, 17, 17),substr(rev_primer, 16, 16),substr(rev_primer, 15, 15), substr(rev_primer, 14, 14), substr(rev_primer, 13, 13), substr(rev_primer, 12, 12), substr(rev_primer, 11, 11), substr(rev_primer, 10, 10), substr(rev_primer, 9, 9), substr(rev_primer, 8, 8), substr(rev_primer, 7, 7), substr(rev_primer, 6, 6), substr(rev_primer, 5, 5), substr(rev_primer, 4, 4), substr(rev_primer, 3, 3), substr(rev_primer, 2, 2), substr(rev_primer, 1, 1)))

data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = paste0("AAAC", rev_primer))
data
```

```{r}
VBC_lib %>%
```

```{r}
#long format - MAGecK
file_list <- list.files(
  path = "MAGeCK/results/MAGECK/AVERAGE",
  pattern = "_average\\.gene_summary\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

extract_interest_wide <- function(file) {
  condition <- basename(file) %>%
    str_remove("_average\\.gene_summary\\.txt$")

  read_delim(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(gene = id) %>%
    mutate(condition = condition)
}

MAGeCK_long <- 
  map_dfr(file_list, extract_interest_wide)

MAGeCK_long
```

```{r}
#data long - add metadata
MAGeCK_long <-
  MAGeCK_long %>%
  rename(drug = condition) %>%
        mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_T0"), "T0", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_plasmid"), "Control", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_BI2865_"), "BI-2865", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_MRTX1133_"), "MRTX1133", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_RMC6236_"), "RMC-6236", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_A3BI3_"), "ACBI3", drug))

MAGeCK_long %>%
  count(drug)

MAGeCK_long %>%
  write.csv("Cas9_supplemental_table.csv")
```
